title: ComputeSDK Benchmark Result
description: Schema for benchmark result files produced by ComputeSDK Benchmarks (e.g., results/sequential_tti/latest.json).

version.description: Schema/data version of the result file.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this result set was produced.

environment.description: Context about where and how the benchmark ran (runner, region, CI, etc.).

config.description: Benchmark configuration used for this run (iterations, concurrency, file sizes, models, etc.).

results.description: One entry per provider/mode combination tested.

nestedMetricMap.description: A map from sub-metric names (e.g., action types) to metric objects.

metric.description: A single performance metric with percentile statistics.

median.description: Median value across all successful iterations.

avg.description: Arithmetic mean across all successful iterations.

mode.description: Test mode for this result (e.g., sequential, staggered, burst, cold, warm).

model.description: Model name, used for AI-gateway benchmarks.

bucket.description: Bucket identifier, used for storage benchmarks.

fileSizeBytes.description: File size in bytes, used for storage benchmarks.

skipped.description: Whether this provider was skipped for this run.

skipReason.description: Reason the provider was skipped, if applicable.

summary.description: Aggregated metrics for this provider result. Top-level keys are metric names (e.g., ttiMs, uploadMs, totalMs). Most values are metric objects; some suites also group related metrics under a single key (e.g., perActionType maps action names to metric objects).

compositeScore.description: Composite 0-100 score blending timing metrics and success rate, when applicable.

successRate.description: Fraction of iterations that succeeded (0.0 to 1.0).
